record.context_brief: Dolbeault-type invariants for almost complex manifolds
record.original_question: For an almost-complex manifold M, are the dimensions h^{p,q} defined as the kernel dimensions of the d-bar Laplacian independent of the choice of Hermitian metric, and if not, is there a replacement notion of h^{p,q} depending only on the almost-complex structure that extends Dolbeault cohomology from the integrable case?

evidence.quote: Problem 20 (Kodaira-Spencer). Let Mn be an almost-complex manifold. Choose an Hermitian structure and consider the numbers h^{p,q} defined as above. Is h^{p,q} independent of the choice of the Hermitian structure? If not, give some other definition of the h^{p,q} of Mn which depends only on the almost-complex structure and which generalizes the h^{p,q} of a complex manifold.
There seems to have been no progress at all on this problem, which asks for a development of harmonic Dolbeault theory on arbitrary almost complex manifolds.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a compact almost complex manifold of real dimension $2n$, with almost complex structure $J$. For each Hermitian metric $g$ compatible with $J$, decompose complex-valued differential forms into types $(p,q)$ using $J$, and define the operator $\bar\partial : \Omega^{p,q}(M) \to \Omega^{p,q+1}(M)$ as the $(0,1)$-component of the exterior derivative $d$ acting on $(p,q)$-forms. Let $\bar\partial^*$ be the formal adjoint of $\bar\partial$ with respect to $g$, and define the Dolbeault Laplacian
$$\Delta_{\bar\partial} = \bar\partial\,\bar\partial^* + \bar\partial^*\bar\partial$$
acting on $\Omega^{p,q}(M)$. Set
$$h^{p,q}(M, J, g) := \dim_{\mathbb{C}} \ker\bigl(\Delta_{\bar\partial}\bigr|_{\Omega^{p,q}(M)}\bigr).$$

(a) Is $h^{p,q}(M, J, g)$ independent of the choice of compatible Hermitian metric $g$ (depending only on $(M, J)$)?

(b) If the answer to (a) is negative, provide a definition of numerical invariants $h^{p,q}(M, J)$ that depends only on the almost complex structure $J$ and that, in the case where $J$ is integrable, recovers the usual Dolbeault cohomology dimensions $\dim_{\mathbb{C}} H^{p,q}_{\bar\partial}(M)$.
artifact.category_tag: Almost complex manifolds and Dolbeault cohomology
artifact.status_search_result: Part (a) has been answered negatively: Holt and Zhang (2020/2022, "Dolbeault cohomology for almost complex manifolds") showed on the Kodaira-Thurston manifold that $h^{0,1}$ depends on the choice of almost Hermitian metric. Part (b) — finding a fully satisfactory metric-independent replacement extending Dolbeault cohomology — remains an active area of research, with several proposed generalizations (Cirici-Wilson, Holt-Zhang, Tomassini and collaborators) and ongoing work on Bott-Chern/Aeppli analogues and on dimension 4 (e.g., 2023 work on the Kodaira-Spencer problem on almost Hermitian 4-manifolds).

status_evidence.title: Dolbeault cohomology for almost complex manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Holt and Zhang prove that on the Kodaira-Thurston manifold, the dimension h^{0,1} of Dolbeault-harmonic (0,1)-forms varies with the choice of almost Hermitian metric.
status_evidence.claim: Part (a) of the Kodaira-Spencer problem is answered negatively.

status_evidence.title: On the Kodaira-Spencer's problem on almost Hermitian 4-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2023) work investigating the Kodaira-Spencer problem in real dimension 4 and proposing further generalizations.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of finding metric-independent replacements remains active.

status_evidence.title: Bott-Chern harmonic forms and primitive decompositions on compact almost Kähler manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies metric-dependence of Bott-Chern-like Laplacian kernels on almost complex manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Generalizations to Bott-Chern/Aeppli settings are being actively developed.
